title: Red Fox (Vulpes vulpes) (W1CDR0001529 BD12)
author: Aubrey John Williams / The British Library
changes: A red fox (Vulpes vulpes) giving a double bark, recorded at Pinbury Park, Gloucestershire, England, on 9 January 1977. Trimmed to 1.90–3.80 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
